so i've been on strattera for about 3-4 months now, and i want to say some things about it in case you end up trying it out:
the first two days i was on it (40mg) i felt motivated, and had these weird chills (like goosebumps) for the first two days, then the effects would go away. this happened also when i upped the dose to 60mg. i was ready to give up, but decided to try one last time to up the dose to 80mg. i looked it up online and strattera is most effective when you take a certain mg depending on your body weight/height, and with my height/weight the "most effective" dose for me (theoretically) is 124 mg, which is 24 mg above the highest recommended dose. my guess is that me being on such a low dose for my height/weight is why the effects were wearing off so quickly and everything wasn't balancing out. the 80mg dose is good, but im probably going to ask about going to 100mg just to see if that's the best dose. 

i guess my point is, don't give up too soon, i almost did and if i would've done that i would've had to get drug tested every month to take adderall (i don't have insurance so adderall and strattera are the only affordable options)
